AdverseEventSerious.description: Report-level seriousness filter, independent of reaction outcome.

AdverseEventSource.description: An explicit source; never probe the other family.
x-enum-descriptions: Explicit CDC WONDER vaccine aggregate tables.

PartialDate.description: A Gregorian date preserving year, month or day precision. The parser additionally validates the calendar day, including leap years.

Text.description: Bounded nonempty text with surrounding Unicode whitespace removed.

description: Search five report headers by default. MAUDE accepts device text or a manufacturer, product-code or problem filter. One report may list several devices; filters may match different devices. VAERS accepts MMR, COVID19, COVID-19 vaccine or one exact qualified native influenza code, matched without case; use influenza to list codes and labels. Tables remain separate and are never summed. One report may list several vaccines. VAERS returns five reported symptom rows by default; seriousness and age select independent tables. Counts are reports, not people. Reports do not show that a vaccine caused an event and cannot measure risk or compare vaccine safety.

limit.description: Native report headers or VAERS rows per page; default five.

manufacturer.description: MAUDE manufacturer phrase on device.manufacturer_d_name. A report may list several devices; filters may match different devices.

offset.description: Native row offset. VAERS continuation requires its retained snapshot.

product_code.description: MAUDE exact native device.device_report_product_code; repeated codes join with OR.

reaction.description: FAERS MedDRA term phrase match, not exact equality.

received_from.description: Inclusive FAERS or MAUDE FDA receipt lower bound, YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM; a month starts on its first day.

received_to.description: Inclusive FAERS or MAUDE FDA receipt upper bound, YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM; a month ends on its last day.

section.description: Independent VAERS table; omitted means reported symptoms.

serious.description: FAERS report flag: any uses the source seriousness flag; the specific flags can overlap. Never a reaction outcome.

snapshot.description: Retained VAERS table for provider-free continuation.

source.description: FAERS by default; VAERS accepts only exact supported vaccine names.

text.description: Literal drug text, MAUDE device phrase or exact supported VAERS vaccine.

title: AdverseEventSearchCommand
